text: {"lessons":["I repeatedly sold winners for modest gains, then bought back later; I should avoid treating a gain as a reason to sell and use a consistent plan instead.","I bought Stock C at a much higher price and later sold it at a steep loss, showing that avoiding regret is not a strategy; I should reassess each holding based on its outlook and risk.","Selling losing positions and then buying some back soon after suggests reactive timing; I should consider the whole portfolio and set clear rules before trading rather than chasing short-term moves."]}
